adaptationNote: The unchanged shared course_test.hpp from Book II B02-L0110 is placed first; the local include is removed. CHECK stays active in optimized builds.

guide.problem: Explore choices with a clear stopping rule.
guide.design: Recursion reduces a problem; backtracking restores mutable choice state before the next branch. Iteration may avoid deep call stacks.
guide.invariant: Each recursive step moves toward a base case; branch-local changes are undone.
guide.failure: Forgetting to pop a chosen character leaks one branch into the next. A base case that never becomes reachable exhausts the stack.
guide.trace: Length-two binary strings follow 00,01,10,11 when 0 is explored first.
guide.maintenance: Bound depth and input size, and separate search order from correctness.
guide.scope: This panel connects this listing to its chapter’s problem. Short demonstrations illustrate one part; the chapter’s complete implementation and invariant labs test the broader contract.
